description: This file defines a testing utility for managing isolated environment states in Swift, including thread-safe lock mechanisms and helper functions for environment variables and user defaults restoration during testing.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor providing a thread-safe lock mechanism to manage exclusive access during test setup and teardown.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a closure within a temporarily isolated environment, restoring environment variables and user defaults afterward.
parameters: env: Dictionary of environment variables to set
defaults: Dictionary of user defaults to set
body: Async closure to execute within the isolated environment

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Convenience method to execute a closure with specific environment variables set, isolated from the rest.
parameters: values: Environment variables to set temporarily

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Convenience method to execute a closure with specific user defaults set, isolated from the rest.
parameters: values: User defaults to set temporarily

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates and returns a temporary file path for test configuration, UUID-based.
